title: TransformControls — translate / rotate / scale gizmo
description: Interactive demo of TransformControls. Click any coloured box to attach the controls. G / R / S switch translate / rotate / scale modes; Q toggles world vs local space; + / - resize the rig in pixels; X / Y / Z toggle axis visibility; T / U / V enable translation / rotation / scale snap; Esc detaches. Drag, hover, and onObjectChange events stream to the lower-left log.
